scope: CPU-only target audit and untrained PointNeXt-Transformer interface; no optimizer or fit
target_policy: Audit unpruned full-chain grid in actual rectangular voxel-cell bounds; no automatic promotion of historical canonical pruning
normalization: Unchanged ordinary BatchNorm; fresh untrained buffers; differences are diagnostic, not a learned normalization verdict
gradient_objective: Synthetic sum of squared local centers, logits and radii for execution only; not a training loss
